cards.target: Precisa-se de funcionários com experiência.
cards.english: Experienced employees are needed.

cards.target: Eu lhe dei o recado.
cards.english: I gave him/her the message.

cards.target: A casa foi reformada recentemente.
cards.english: The house was recently renovated.

cards.target: Aqui se respira ar puro.
cards.english: You breathe clean air here.

cards.target: Não se deve julgar pelas aparências.
cards.english: One shouldn't judge by appearances.

cards.target: É obrigatório o uso de cinto de segurança.
cards.english: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory.

cards.target: É proibido fumar neste recinto.
cards.english: Smoking is prohibited in this area.

cards.target: É conveniente reservar com antecedência.
cards.english: It's advisable to book in advance.

cards.target: Os resultados foram divulgados hoje de manhã.
cards.english: The results were released this morning.

cards.target: Não se pode fazer barulho depois das dez.
cards.english: You can't make noise after ten.

cards.target: Tampouco ele sabia da reunião.
cards.english: He didn't know about the meeting either.

cards.target: A conta foi paga pela empresa.
cards.english: The bill was paid by the company.

cards.target: Não se aceita cartão neste estabelecimento.
cards.english: Cards are not accepted in this establishment.

cards.target: É necessário apresentar documento com foto.
cards.english: It's necessary to present a photo ID.

cards.target: Nota-se uma melhora significativa no desempenho.
cards.english: A significant improvement in performance is evident.

cards.target: O tratamento foi indicado pelo especialista.
cards.english: The treatment was recommended by the specialist.

cards.target: De qualquer forma, obrigado pela ajuda.
cards.english: In any case, thanks for the help.

cards.target: Os livros foram doados para a biblioteca.
cards.english: The books were donated to the library.

cards.target: Por enquanto, vamos manter o plano original.
cards.english: For now, let's keep the original plan.

cards.target: Se ele não fosse tão orgulhoso, pediria desculpas.
cards.english: If he weren't so proud, he'd apologize.

cards.target: A nova sede foi inaugurada no mês passado.
cards.english: The new headquarters was inaugurated last month.

cards.target: A reunião foi adiada para a semana que vem.
cards.english: The meeting was postponed to next week.

cards.target: Por fim, gostaria de agradecer a todos os presentes.
cards.english: Finally, I'd like to thank everyone present.

cards.target: De maneira que todos possam ouvir, fale mais alto.
cards.english: So that everyone can hear, speak louder.

cards.target: O problema foi resolvido pela equipe técnica.
cards.english: The problem was solved by the technical team.

cards.target: As ruas foram alagadas pela chuva forte.
cards.english: The streets were flooded by the heavy rain.

cards.target: Se eu fosse mais jovem, aprenderia a surfar.
cards.english: If I were younger, I'd learn to surf.

cards.target: Se eu fosse mais alto, jogaria basquete profissional.
cards.english: If I were taller, I'd play professional basketball.

cards.target: Os dados foram analisados pela equipe de pesquisa.
cards.english: The data was analyzed by the research team.

cards.target: A empresa foi vendida para um grupo estrangeiro.
cards.english: The company was sold to a foreign group.

cards.target: O acordo foi firmado entre as duas nações.
cards.english: The agreement was signed between the two nations.

cards.target: Afinal de contas, quem vai pagar essa conta?
cards.english: After all, who's going to pay this bill?

cards.target: Ele comentou que o novo restaurante era excelente.
cards.english: He commented that the new restaurant was excellent.

cards.target: O chefe ordenou que todos saíssem da sala.
cards.english: The boss ordered everyone to leave the room.

cards.target: Se não tivesse acontecido aquele acidente, ele estaria bem.
cards.english: If that accident hadn't happened, he'd be fine.

cards.target: Se a gente se comunicasse melhor, haveria menos conflito.
cards.english: If we communicated better, there'd be less conflict.

cards.target: Se ele não tivesse mentido, eu ainda confiaria nele.
cards.english: If he hadn't lied, I'd still trust him.

cards.target: Em virtude do mau tempo, o voo foi cancelado.
cards.english: Due to bad weather, the flight was canceled.

cards.target: Ouve-se muito forró no Nordeste.
cards.english: A lot of forró is heard in the Northeast.

cards.target: Comenta-se muito sobre a nova lei.
cards.english: The new law is discussed a lot.

cards.target: Em compensação, o hotel era maravilhoso.
cards.english: To make up for it, the hotel was wonderful.

cards.target: Embora esteja frio, vou sair de camiseta.
cards.english: Although it's cold, I'm going out in a t-shirt.

cards.target: Se eles tivessem perguntado, eu teria explicado tudo.
cards.english: If they had asked, I would have explained everything.

cards.target: A estátua foi erguida em homenagem ao fundador.
cards.english: The statue was erected in honor of the founder.

cards.target: Se ela tivesse se esforçado mais, teria sido aprovada.
cards.english: If she had tried harder, she would have passed.

cards.target: Se nós tivéssemos um barco, pescaríamos nos fins de semana.
cards.english: If we had a boat, we'd fish on weekends.

cards.target: Apesar de estar chovendo, as crianças querem brincar lá fora.
cards.english: Despite the rain, the children want to play outside.

cards.target: Fala-se muito sobre isso nos jornais.
cards.english: This is talked about a lot in the newspapers.

cards.target: Se não tivesse chovido, teríamos feito o churrasco.
cards.english: If it hadn't rained, we would have had the barbecue.

cards.target: Haja vista os resultados, precisamos mudar de estratégia.
cards.english: In view of the results, we need to change strategy.

cards.target: A princípio, concordei, mas depois mudei de ideia.
cards.english: At first, I agreed, but then I changed my mind.

cards.target: Se eu tivesse feito o curso, estaria mais preparado.
cards.english: If I had taken the course, I'd be better prepared.

cards.target: Se houvesse mais segurança, as pessoas andariam mais tranquilas.
cards.english: If there were more security, people would walk more calmly.

cards.target: Se eu tivesse conhecido ela antes, tudo seria diferente.
cards.english: If I had met her earlier, everything would be different.

cards.target: Se a gente tivesse combinado antes, não haveria confusão.
cards.english: If we had agreed beforehand, there wouldn't be any confusion.

cards.target: Se eu pudesse voltar atrás, não teria dito aquilo.
cards.english: If I could go back, I wouldn't have said that.

cards.target: Se eu fosse fluente em português, conseguiria esse emprego.
cards.english: If I were fluent in Portuguese, I'd get this job.

cards.target: Se a escola ensinasse finanças, os jovens seriam mais responsáveis.
cards.english: If schools taught finance, young people would be more responsible.

cards.target: Se ela tivesse aceitado o emprego, estaria morando no exterior.
cards.english: If she had accepted the job, she'd be living abroad.

cards.target: Se ele tivesse se preparado, a apresentação teria sido melhor.
cards.english: If he had prepared, the presentation would have been better.

existing_tips: 'Falar que' is more informal than 'dizer que' for reported speech – very common in Brazilian Portugu
Verbs of recommendation/suggestion in reported speech use the subjunctive: 'recomendou que fizesse'.
'Se' + verb in 3rd person creates a passive/impersonal construction.
